name: Pipeliners - Decisions and Rules
body:
> Decision · Pipeliners · 2026-10-10

Standing rules consolidated from the project CLAUDE.md (rules 1-18), the Session Handoff 2026-10-01 (section 1) and the Company Master Profile (claims and content guidelines). Latest decision wins. Supporting sources: `Session Handoff 2026-10-01.md`, `Pipeliners Company Master Profile.md`.

# Editing scope
1. **Homepage (post 3520): never edit**, OTTO injections included. Flag only. (One approved exception: the Sep 28 strip of 122 hidden OTTO links.)
2. **Ad-touched pages are hands off.** Pull `landing_page_view` for the last 30 days (customer 7219095860) before every edit; any paid impression means protected. Performance Max can show any page. A one-off OK covers one edit only. (Exception from Oct 10: the local page restructure and rebuild skills skip the ad check, per Kim.)
3. **Sign/offer pages are out of scope:** /free-video-inspection/, /free-sewer-inspection/, /free-sewer-repair-estimate/.
4. **Never edit live /services-areas/** without asking.
5. **GBP is read-only.** Report only; Kim or the office posts the daily photo.
6. **Never change phone numbers, tel: links, phone schema or the GHL number pool.** Source number 480-535-6503, GBP 480-447-5345; differences are call tracking. "509-546-4386" regex hits are the OTTO UUID.
7. **Never delete pages or artifacts.** A merge is a 301 plus setting the old post to draft.
8. **Never run `wp cache flush` or `litespeed-purge all`** (the Sep 17 outage wiped OTTO data on 34 of 37 city pages). Purge one URL. JS Minify stays OFF. Same-path media replacement needs an hPanel CDN flush.
9. **Indexing:** free GSC "Request indexing" only, never paid `indexer_*` tools. About 10-13 a day.
10. **Never contact or draft to Search Atlas support.**
11. **Show first, then go live.** Per-item approval. OTTO edits only for approved items. Visible city-page copy goes in as real editable Elementor widgets.
12. **Held:** the two myths posts and /residential-pipe-restoration-guide/. Do not touch or list as pending.
13. **Repiping:** do not change existing repipe wording; never add new repipe claims.
14. **Leave harmless technical items alone** unless Kim names them.
15. **Verify every angle before executing:** re-read live values, guard writes (counts, md5), verify desktop and Googlebot mobile.
16. **Pipeliners only** in this folder; exclude summitplumbingut.com.

# Writing rules
- Say **"Pipeliners"**, never "Pipeliners USA" in new copy (Kim stopped the retroactive site-wide cleanup, so existing USA mentions stay).
- Never "pipe lining"/"pipelining" as a noun, never "pipeline" or "pigging". "Lining the pipe" as an action is fine.
- No em dashes (check all 4 encodings including `—`).
- No prices in new copy; leave existing prices alone.
- No competitor names or links. External links only to .gov, .edu or standards bodies, each returning 200 twice.
- Plain homeowner language. Blog H2s blue `#1a446f`. New blog author Jake Shaker (WP user 7).
- Images: Arizona look (no lawns or basements), 4-inch residential scale, no logos or text; draw the cleanout straight up.
- Scott's blog preferences: about 5 posts a month, few monsoon topics, inside-the-pipe photos.
- City pages (Oct 13): never title a block "Key Takeaways"; use "Quick Facts for <City> Homeowners". On a phone, the call buttons must show on the first screen.

# Claims (Scott, Oct 1)
- **OK:** 20-yr drain-lining and 10-yr ePIPE warranties, liners 50+ yrs, ePIPE 75+ yrs, up to 30% savings, slab leak repair by lining, permits pulled, pressure/acoustic/thermal leak locating.
- **NO:** 24/7, same day (most jobs take a couple of days), full repipes, manhole lining, gas lines, Kitec, pipe bursting.
- **Unconfirmed:** "only ePIPE installer in the state", "licensed ePIPE partners", "All Work / Satisfaction Guaranteed", the hidden homepage price table, ROC currency.
- Note: some older notes in this vault (Aug 19-27) record 24/7 as "confirmed". That was superseded on Oct 1.

# SEO method
- One focus keyword aligned across title, H1, meta, first 100 words, one H2 and a 40-60 word answer block. Never change a title alone; show the alignment table.
- Keyword criteria: volume 100+, KD 0-30, transactional or informational intent. Pick pages by GSC demand, not thinness.
- OTTO edits scoped by url_id; in OTTO internal-link rows the row URL is the destination.

# Reporting
Work-report format, first person "I", never name Kim, full https links, before/after text instead of change codes, report only from 2026-08-26 onward.
